name: Desktop-case PC
definition: complete desktop computer in a low horizontal case made to sit flat on the desk, often under the monitor (historic desktop and small-form-factor desktop).
notes: Shop lists Compaq Evo D510 in Desktop PCs, chassis desktop slimline; Amiga 4000 in horizontal desktop box.

name: Rack-mount server
definition: complete computer in a rack-mount chassis (1U to 4U) made to be fitted in a 19-inch rack.
notes: Dell rack category with 1U and 2U density filters; Supermicro Rackmount Servers category with 1U and 2U systems.

name: Detachable 2-in-1 computer
definition: portable computer whose screen unit detaches from a keyboard that comes with it (a tablet sold with an optional keyboard is D2).
notes: Keyboard usually bundled; Galaxy Book ships with keyboard in box; Pixel Slate keyboard sold separately (D2 side).
